marker.comment: Cropped hard to the right (zoom 1.35) so the gantry stays out of the macros. The tail handle tilts down to the fins and the smoke, which the opening never shows.
marker.name: Framing hides the gantry

marker.comment: Zoomed 1.42 from the top so the dial lettering stays under the letterbox.
marker.name: Framing hides mirrored lettering

marker.comment: Starts with the glove already on the button and cuts before the finger lifts (4.65 s into the source). Extending either end shows the garbled label or the lift.
marker.name: Button label is garbled

marker.comment: Seedance clip. For the first 1.5 s of the source the rockets have glowing blobs on their noses, and the head handle shows them: do not extend the head.
marker.name: Generated shot: keep the head

marker.comment: The second launch tower is composited from the same footage. Keep the crop: wider framing shows a face at the left edge.
marker.name: Composite: second tower

marker.comment: Past the out-point the source flies on past the camera into space (a morph, not a cut). Extend the tail only a few frames.
marker.name: Tail runs on into space

marker.comment: The rival edges ahead by about a length. In the tail handle it pulls far ahead, which the notes on V12.1 ruled out.
marker.name: Keep the rival close

marker.comment: Seedance clip. Zoomed 1.13 from the bottom so the garbled wall sign stays under the letterbox.
marker.name: Generated shot: wall sign

marker.comment: The rival pull-away played backwards, so the gap closes. Exhaust runs in reverse if held long.
marker.name: Reversed footage

marker.comment: The score cuts on the descent and returns on the flag wide. The effects stem carries the landing.
marker.name: Music is silent here

marker.comment: Seedance 7e918801, shifted down 80 px so the whole cap clears the letterbox.
marker.name: New Moon landing shot

marker.comment: The score has faded by +3.6 s; the tray settles at +4.1 s in the quiet.
marker.name: Six samples, then silence
